map.住宿推荐按需求分类：青旅（人均 50 至 150 元/晚）、快捷酒店（150 至: Accommodation recommendations are grouped by need: hostel (CNY 50 to 150 per person per night), budget hotel (CNY 150 to 350), mid to upscale (CNY 350 to 800) and resort (above CNY 800). Booking considerations cover location (within 1 km of a subway station), cancellation policy, rating (prefer 4.5 or above) and review count (more than 100 reviews is more meaningful). Accommodation budget = nightly rate × nights × rooms.
